216: Jake Blues, just released from prison, puts his old band back together to save the Catholic home where he and his brother Elwood were raised.
They'll never get caught. They're on a mission from God.

Once you see him, nothing can save you.

On air. Off shore. Out of control.

Little People. Big Trouble. Lots of fun.

Say hola to his little friends.

Lester Long never forgets a friend.

Flunk 'em if they can't take a joke.

To avoid fainting keep repeating, it's only a movie... Only a movie... Only a movie...
Dr. John Collingwood (as Gaylord St. James)

The film that introduced Bossa Nova to the world...

So many women. So little time.

Hubert Bonisseur de La Bath, alias OSS 117

Evil will do anything to live.

Why do women always have to put up a fight?

Khiva (as Kimursi of the Kipsigi Tribe)
Umbopa (as Siriaque of the Watussi Tribe)
Chief Gagool (as Sekaryongo of the Watussi Tribe)

Love is a force of nature

Some doors should never be opened.

You'll meet some interesting people and hear some great songs at the Monster Club

They came. They saw. They came.

Winning is Just the Beginning Surviving is Another Story

The FBI thought they had him. It was the other way around.

It comes back at you again and again!

How far would you go to build a new life?

Fight for the light. Silence the darkness.

No one needs anything here. It's all about want.

What do you allow to define you?

Meet the man of your dreams.

An unexpected encounter. An unlikely bond. An unforgettable adventure.
24024: Housewives Alice and Celine are best friends and neighbours who seem to have it all. However, when a tragic accident shatters the harmony of their lives, guilt, suspicion and paranoia begin to unravel their sisterly bond.
Sometimes it's the only thing you can trust.

The true story that became a musical sensation.

26840: During the Hyderabad Liberation Movement of 1948, there will be atrocities, like the episode of Gundrampally, Parkala, Bhairanpally villages.
27096: Sathyajith, Assistant Commissioner of Police, along with his team is assigned to handle controversial and complicated cases. One day, while fishing on a lake side, a man finds a garbage bag trapped inside his net.

EEK!!! Lock the doors! Bolt the windows! It's...

Can our heroes save the village and put a stop to the Gurumes Army?
28120: Struggling to cope after a move to the city with his mother, Elmer runs away in search of Wild Island and a young dragon who waits to be rescued. Elmer’s adventures introduce him to ferocious beasts, a mysterious island and the friendship of a lifetime.

Would you give up what you need... to get everything you want?

30168: Julio, a young fisherman from a provincial village, descends into social alienation as he arrives in Manila to search for his loved one.

No one can take away what we carry inside.

Hope Shines in the Darkest Places

The mammoth musical of Jerome Kern's dramatic life story

They're the Best Man for the job.

Sometimes the person you least expect can help you find your way home.
